description: Security policies for an autonomous healthcare insurance claims agent.

policies.name: approved_resource_boundary
policies.description: The agent should not access resources outside its approved working area.

policies.name: approved_data_destinations
policies.description: The agent should not write, transfer, or persist data to unapproved destinations.

policies.name: sensitive_resource_access
policies.description: Access to explicitly classified resources should be reviewed against declared resource tags and prior approval requirements.

policies.name: approved_external_sources
policies.description: The agent should retrieve external information only from approved sources.

policies.name: sensitive_data_persistence
policies.description: Persistence of restricted resource content in memory requires stakeholder review.

policies.name: dependency_integrity
policies.description: Dependency manifest modifications and related staging and commit operations should be reviewed against approved dependency requirements.

policies.name: excessive_tool_usage
policies.description: Excessive tool usage and repeated operations should be reviewed for potential resource exhaustion and denial-of-service conditions.
